name: GRIDSTORM Squad Mate
tagline: A co-op wingman for the GRIDSTORM arcade shooter: your bots fly formation with you
description: A squad mate for the GRIDSTORM arcade shooter that gets your bots into formation alongside you in real time. Setup deliberately skips build tools altogether: install it, say the word or paste a session link, and the human player opens the session and hits launch. Co-op arcade play without a toolchain in sight.
author: TheMattyFG
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
